info.title: Life Manager API
info.description: Life Manager API — personal productivity platform with task management, calendar, events, and user authentication.

requestBody.description: Registration details including email, username, and password.

400.description: Invalid registration data or email/username already exists.

get.summary: Exports all data belonging to the authenticated user as a JSON archive.
Get all events for the authenticated user with optional filtering.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Filter events that end on or after this date.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Filter events that start on or before this date.

get.summary: Get a specific event by ID.

post.summary:
Share an event with another user.
Caller must be the event owner or have Manage permission.

requestBody.description: Share request containing the recipient's username or email and permission level.

get.summary:
List all shares for an event.
Caller must be the event owner or have Manage permission.

put.summary:
Update the permission level on an existing share.
Caller must be the event owner or have Manage permission.

delete.summary: Revoke (delete) a share. Owner can revoke any share; Manage users can only revoke shares they created.

get.summary: Returns recent log entries from today's log file.

parameters.name: lines
parameters.description: Maximum number of entries to return (default 200, max 1000).

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: Filter by level: all, INF, WRN, ERR (default all).

get.summary: Gets the current user's settings. Creates defaults if none exist.
Gets the WIP (Work In Progress) summary for the current user.
Get all pending event invitations for the authenticated user.
Get weekly statistics for the specified week.

parameters.name: weekStart
parameters.description: Start date of the week (defaults to current week)

get.summary: Get daily statistics for the specified date.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Date to get statistics for (defaults to today)

get.summary: Get urgent tasks for the current or specified week.

parameters.name: weekStart
parameters.description: Start date of the week (defaults to current week)

get.summary: Get historical completion rate statistics for the past N weeks.

parameters.name: weeks
parameters.description: Number of weeks to retrieve (1-52, defaults to 8)

post.summary: Creates a subtask under the specified parent task.

get.summary: Lists subtasks of the specified parent task. Use ?includeNested=true for the full tree.

post.summary: Creates multiple subtasks at once from a list of titles.

put.summary: Reorders the direct subtasks of a parent task.
Moves a subtask to a new parent. Set newParentId to null to promote to a root task.
Marks all direct subtasks of the parent task as completed.

get.summary: Returns completion progress statistics for the subtasks of a task.

delete.summary: Deletes a subtask. Use ?cascade=false to promote children instead of deleting them.

get.summary: Get current system configuration.
Lists tasks. By default returns only root-level tasks (no parents). Pass rootOnly=false to include subtasks.
Gets a single task by ID. Use ?includeSubtasks=true to include the full subtask tree.

patch.summary: Updates the status of a task (NotStarted, InProgress, Blocked, Completed).
Classify a task with urgency and importance levels for the Eisenhower Matrix.

post.summary: Bulk classify multiple tasks with urgency and importance levels.

get.summary: Get tasks grouped by Eisenhower Matrix quadrant.
Get auto-classification suggestion for a single task based on priority and due date.

post.summary: Preview auto-classification suggestions for all unclassified tasks.

patch.summary: Set the energy level for a task (Low, Medium, High).
Set the estimated duration for a task in minutes.

post.summary: Bulk set energy level for multiple tasks.

get.summary:
Get task suggestions filtered by energy level and available time.
Returns up to 10 non-completed tasks matching the criteria, sorted by urgency, due date, and priority.
Get energy level distribution statistics across all root tasks.
Get all users with optional filtering and pagination
Get user statistics
Get current version information from VERSION.json
Get all version history from CHANGELOG.md
Get specific version by number

LifeApi.Features.Tasks.DTOs.BulkCreateSu.description: Request to create multiple subtasks at once from a list of titles.

LifeApi.Features.Tasks.DTOs.CreateSubtas.description: Request to create a single subtask under a parent task.

LifeApi.Features.Tasks.DTOs.MoveSubtaskR.description: Request to move a subtask to a new parent. Set NewParentId to null to promote to root.

LifeApi.Features.Tasks.DTOs.ReorderSubta.description: Request to reorder subtasks under a parent task.

LifeApi.Features.Tasks.DTOs.SubtaskProgr.description: Progress statistics for subtasks of a given task.

Bearer.description: JWT Authorization header using the Bearer scheme. Enter 'Bearer' [space] and then your token in the text input below. Example: 'Bearer 12345abcdef'
Bearer.name: Authorization
